title: Award Allowability Terms Extraction — Output
description: Structured record of the federal award terms that govern cost allowability: period of performance, approved budget, caps and exclusions, federal prior-approval triggers, indirect-cost treatment, and institutional compliance-approval requirements. Input-normalization contract for the federal cost-allowability analysis workflow.

award_number.description: Federal Award Identification Number as printed on the award.

sponsor.description: Awarding federal agency or pass-through entity.

pre_award_cost_window.description: Authorized pre-award spending window, when stated.

applicable_cost_principles.description: Cost principles the award invokes (e.g., 2 CFR 200 Subpart E).

approved_budget_categories.description: Approved budget categories. Empty array when the award does not enumerate them.

approved_amount.description: Approved amount as a JSON number; null when not stated.

caps_and_exclusions.description: Explicit dollar caps, percentage limits, prohibited cost types, or use restrictions. Empty array when none.

prior_approval_triggers.description: Actions requiring federal sponsor prior approval before a cost is incurred. Empty array when none.

mtdc_exclusions.description: Cost types the base excludes. Empty array when not stated.

compliance_approval_requirements.description: Award terms conditioning spending or performance on an institutional regulatory approval (IRB, IACUC, IBC, or similar). Empty array when none.

special_conditions.description: High-risk conditions, enhanced monitoring, or other special terms. Empty array when none.

referenced_documents.description: Governing documents incorporated by reference. Empty array when none.
